name: only

arguments.name: $params
accepts: a positive or negative index, a whole number other than 0; a unit or a fraction makes a selector the browser drops, and 0 matches nothing, so both are refused
a multiple of n such as 3n, for every third element; an offset such as 2n+1 is computed by Sass first and arrives as 3n
several indexes, all of them numbers

caveats: An+B with an offset cannot be passed as a number: Sass does the arithmetic, so `only(2n+1)` becomes `3n` and selects every third element, not the odd ones. Use `odd` or `even`, or a coefficient alone such as `3n`.
